title: TC01 Homepage catalog
expected result: Shop QA Demo displays three named products, their expected prices and detail links.
steps: Open the homepage. Verify Shop QA Demo, product count 3, Wireless Mouse priced ₹799, Mechanical Keyboard priced ₹1299, Studio Headphones priced ₹2499 and a visible View details link for each product.

title: TC02 Exact search input
expected result: The search field retains the exact entered text wireless mouse.
steps: Open the homepage, enter wireless mouse in the Search products field, verify its exact input value before submission and verify the Search button is visible.

title: TC03 Mixed case search
expected result: Searching for MoUsE with surrounding spaces returns product count 1 and Wireless Mouse.
steps: Open the homepage, enter two spaces followed by MoUsE followed by two spaces, click Search and verify the result count is 1 with Wireless Mouse visible.

title: TC04 Search with no matches
expected result: An unmatched query displays product count 0 and No products found.
steps: Search for zz_no_match_987 and verify product count 0 and the visible message No products found.

title: TC05 Empty search
expected result: Clearing a previous search displays product count 3 and all catalog products.
steps: Open /search?q=mouse, clear the search field, click Search and verify product count 3 and all three catalog products are visible.

title: TC06 Product details
expected result: Each catalog detail link opens the matching product with its description, correct price and Add to cart.
steps: Open the catalog and follow each View details link separately. Verify /products/mouse with Wireless Mouse and ₹799, /products/keyboard with Mechanical Keyboard and ₹1299, and /products/headphones with Studio Headphones and ₹2499. On every detail page verify the matching title, a visible description and Add to cart button. Return to the catalog between products.

title: TC07 Add Wireless Mouse
expected result: Adding Wireless Mouse once changes fresh cart count 0 to 1 and displays Added to cart.
steps: Open a fresh /products/mouse page and verify cart count 0. Click Add to cart once, then verify cart count 1 and the visible confirmation Added to cart. Retain these expected values even if the application has a defect.

title: TC08 Health endpoint
expected result: GET /api/health returns HTTP 200 with status ok.
steps: Request GET /api/health on the connected origin. Verify HTTP status 200 and a response body containing the status property equal to ok.
